name: calculate
description: Write live Excel formulas (INDEX/MATCH / SUMIFS / #REF! repair) onto a new sheet; never paste dead totals

tools.name: calculate_table
tools.description: Write LIVE formulas to a NEW sheet (never overwrite sources, never paste computed totals). op lookup: INDEX/MATCH from rightTable into leftTable by key (exact match; works without XLOOKUP). op sumifs: unique groupBy + SUMIFS on valueColumn. op fix_ref: copy a sheet with #REF! arguments dropped. Tables must already exist (use ensure_table first).

bringColumns.description: lookup: columns to fetch from right, comma-separated

outputSheet.description: New sheet name. Default 查找结果 / 汇总结果 / 公式修复
